tools.name: offboard_user_account
tools.description: Offboards a user by revoking all of their roles and API tokens, deleting their account record and sessions, and sending a notification email to the user's manager.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user account to offboard

params.name: manager_email
params.description: Email address of the manager to notify

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

DATABASE_PATH = "accounts.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.internal.example.com"
SENDER_ADDRESS = "accounts@example.com"


def offboard_user_account(user_id: str, manager_email: str) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
        database_cursor.execute(
            "SELECT username, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)
        )
        retrieved_user_row = database_cursor.fetchone()
        if retrieved_user_row is None:
            return {"success": False, "error": "user not found"}
        retrieved_username, retrieved_user_email = retrieved_user_row

        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
        number_of_roles_revoked = database_cursor.rowcount
        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM api_tokens WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
        number_of_tokens_revoked = database_cursor.rowcount
        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
        number_of_sessions_deleted = database_cursor.rowcount
        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
        database_connection.commit()
    except Exception:
        database_connection.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

    notification_message = EmailMessage()
    notification_message["Subject"] = f"Account offboarded: {retrieved_username}"
    notification_message["From"] = SENDER_ADDRESS
    notification_message["To"] = manager_email
    notification_message.set_content(
        f"The account for {retrieved_username} ({retrieved_user_email}) was removed.\n"
        f"Roles revoked: {number_of_roles_revoked}\n"
        f"Tokens revoked: {number_of_tokens_revoked}\n"
        f"Sessions deleted: {number_of_sessions_deleted}\n"
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST) as smtp_connection:
        smtp_connection.send_message(notification_message)

    return {
        "success": True,
        "user_id": user_id,
        "roles_revoked": number_of_roles_revoked,
        "tokens_revoked": number_of_tokens_revoked,
        "sessions_deleted": number_of_sessions_deleted,
    }

tools.name: run_admin_promotion_job
tools.description: Grants the admin role to a user by running the promotion script on the server.
tools.code:
import subprocess
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def run_admin_promotion_job(username: str) -> dict:
    completed_process = subprocess.run(
        ["/opt/accounts/bin/grant_role.sh", "--user", username, "--role", "admin"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=60,
    )
    result = {
        "username": username,
        "role": "admin",
        "exit_code": completed_process.returncode,
        "output": completed_process.stdout.strip(),
        "errors": completed_process.stderr.strip(),
        "success": completed_process.returncode == 0,
    }
    return result

tools.name: close_account_and_notify_webhook
tools.description: Marks a user's account as closed with a reason, deletes their saved sessions and stored preferences, and posts a closure event to the billing service webhook.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the account to close

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DATABASE_PATH = "accounts.db"
BILLING_WEBHOOK_URL = "https://billing.internal.example.com/hooks/account-closed"


@tool
def close_account_and_notify_webhook(user_id: str, reason: str) -> str:
    closed_at_timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    connection.execute(
        "UPDATE users SET status = 'closed', closed_reason = ?, closed_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (reason, closed_at_timestamp, user_id),
    )
    connection.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
    connection.execute("DELETE FROM user_preferences WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()
    payload = {
        "event": "account.closed",
        "user_id": user_id,
        "reason": reason,
        "closed_at": closed_at_timestamp,
    }
    response = requests.post(BILLING_WEBHOOK_URL, json=payload, timeout=15)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return f"Account {user_id} closed at {closed_at_timestamp}; billing webhook returned {response.status_code}"
